title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber I Cap. 8 densify complete)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber I Cap. 8 De sacrae Scripturae efficacia COMPLETE (PHYS mid-276–mid-290 before Cap. 8).
blurb: Ludwig Crocius — Book I Chapter 8 On Sacred Scripture's efficacy, from the 1636 Bremen Latin. Densify COMPLETE (PHYS mid-276–mid-290): efficacy defined as Scripture's property of illuminating and vivifying by the Spirit's elevated instrument; differs from mere perspicuity; objective and effective efficacy; letter alone does not convert; prior grace-light required; Scripture reading for all; against papal vernacular bans, intermittent reading, laity bans, and hanging-Scripture superstition. Cap. 8 On Scripture's efficacy begins mid PHYS 276; Cap. 6 complete; the rest of the Syntagma remains.
